current.text: He missed most of last season with a significant injury.
He will compete for point guard minutes behind Ty Jerome, who is expected to start at point guard.
The Memphis guard group is crowded: Javon Small, Ty Jerome, Pippen, Campazzo and Cam Spencer.
Coach Tuomas Iisalo runs an 11-man rotation with short stints and keeps minutes down, which limits a backup guard's minutes.

durable.text: Steals are his standout category. He projects for about 1.8 steals per game, far above the top 250 pool.
His FT% is weak for a guard, at about 74% projected on low volume.

tags.name: minutes competition
tags.detail: backup point guard behind Ty Jerome in a crowded guard group

note: Both Yahoo and ESPN value him at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 183, ESPN rank 144), so he sits on the edge of our 144-player draft pool. At most he is a 1 USD late pick. His value comes almost entirely from steals (about 1.8 per game), with some assists. That helps steals-heavy and punt FT% builds, but his projected 2.5 turnovers per game hurt. Early in the season, check whether he gets the roughly 24 minutes ESPN projects behind Ty Jerome in Iisalo's 11-man rotation. If he does not, leave him on waivers.
